regulation.matchSavedDemotedToast: Match rules saved. The phase returned to Draft.

regulation.hasTieExtraTimeHint: Allows extra time to decide the confrontation.
regulation.hasTiePenaltyHint: Allows a shootout to decide the confrontation when still level.

structure.emptyBody: Configure the structure to create the main stage.
structure.matchGenerationHint: League / groups only. Cup and Swiss ignore this setting.
structure.swissRoundHint: Planned number of rounds. Matchdays are created as the competition progresses, round by round.
structure.configureHint: Creates the primary stage skeleton (first-time setup).
structure.rebuildImpact: Rebuild will delete the current structure and recreate it from this configuration. Currently generated elements will be lost.

skeleton.formatAwaitingType: Choose a type to define the phase organisation.
skeleton.discardMessage: What you entered will be lost.
skeleton.editDiscardMessage: The parameters you entered will be lost.

formatTile.Championship: A single pool, matchdays, and a standing.
formatTile.Groups: Several groups with a defined place capacity.

skeleton.editLede: Rebuilds the phase organisation (same type). No draw or relation is created.

fiche.activateDrawBody: Allows placing this phase’s teams by draw.
fiche.manualPlacementCtaBody: Assign a team from this phase to a cup place.

drawWorkflow.kindUnsupported: This phase format does not support creating a draw from Structure yet.

short.unsupported: Draw not available for this format.
short.emptyPoolUpstream: Wait until upstream supplies the teams.

detail.emptyPool: This phase’s teams must be added before starting a draw.

detail.countMismatch: The draw needs {{places}} teams for {{places}} places. The current composition has {{count}}.

manualPlacement.title: Manual placement — {{phase}}
manualPlacement.lead: Assign a team from this phase to a cup place. This is not a draw.
manualPlacement.emptyPool: No team is available for this place.
manualPlacement.blockedQualProg: This place is fed by Qualification or Progression. Edit Sorties on the source phase.
manualPlacement.blockedDraw: This place is populated by a draw. Release draw placements first if you want a manual assignment.
manualPlacement.blockedUnavailable: This place is not available for manual placement.

composition.title: Teams — {{phase}}
composition.lede: Add teams to this phase. Places already expected from Qualification / Progression are reserved.
composition.atCapacityHint: No room left for teams ({{n}} max).

progression.title: Progression — {{phase}}
progression.hint: Define who advances from a round’s outcomes and where they go next — another phase’s entries, or a Place (a specific slot; the team also joins that phase’s entries).
progression.hintFromDestination: Define who advances from this phase into the next phase’s entries. Changes are saved on {{source}}, not on the phase you opened from.
progression.roundWinnerLockedHint: Winners exit from the last round of the main bracket path (e.g. the final).
progression.roundNeedsFixturesHint: Rounds exist, but no fixtures have been created yet — exits cannot expand until fixtures exist.
progression.outcomeWinnerHint: Winners of the confrontations in the phase’s last round
progression.outcomeLoserHint: Losers of the confrontations in the selected round
progression.incompleteHintChampionshipTerminalRound: Winner requires the last round of the main bracket path
progression.kindPlaceHint: A specific place in the phase
progression.placeEmpty: No labeled place on this destination phase.
progression.placeMapAria: Map each match to a place
progression.placeMapEmptySelection: Choose a round to map places.
progression.placeFillHint: Maps remaining empty paths to available places, in round order. Existing choices are kept.
progression.saveBlockedDuplicatePlace: Several progressions target the same place
progression.tileContributionAria: Expected teams for {{phase}}: {{count}} of {{capacity}} places; + {{draft}} from this progression
progression.overCapacityWarning: Progression rules configured here send {{count}} teams to “{{phase}}” (including +{{draft}} from this draft), which has {{capacity}} places.
progression.incompleteHintPlaceUnavailable: Place editing unavailable — switch to Entries or change phase
progression.emptyBody: Add a rule, or save to clear any existing rules.
progression.emptyNoPeerBody: Add a downstream phase in Structure before defining exits (Entries or Place). Connections inside a phase belong to its organisation.
progression.emptyNoPlacePeerBody: Place mode only lists Cup phases whose organisation exposes labeled places. No downstream phase is eligible. Choose Entries, or set up a downstream Cup phase.

qualification.title: Qualifications — {{phase}}
qualification.hint: Define who qualifies from this phase and where — another phase’s entries, or a Place (a specific slot; the team also joins that phase’s entries).
qualification.hintFromDestination: Define who qualifies from this phase and which phase they feed next. Changes are saved on {{source}}, not on the phase you opened from.
qualification.kindPlaceHint: A specific place in the phase
qualification.kindPlaceUnavailable: No downstream phase exposes addressable places (Cup, Groups, Championship, or Swiss). Use Entries, or set up a downstream phase.
qualification.placeSelectPending: Choose a labeled place on the destination phase.
qualification.placeEmpty: No labeled place on this destination phase.
qualification.placeMapAria: Map each selection to a place
qualification.placeMapEmptySelection: Complete the selection above to map places.
qualification.placeFillHint: Maps remaining empty paths to available places, in the order shown. Existing choices are kept.
qualification.saveBlockedDuplicatePlace: Several qualifications target the same place
qualification.scopeAcrossHint: Same place in each group, then re-rank
qualification.acrossPlaceHint: The {{place}} from each group form the standing. E.g. all 3rds, then take the best and 2nd best of that standing.
qualification.acrossAmongHintRange: From {{from}} to {{to}} in that across-groups standing
qualification.tileContributionAria: Expected teams for {{phase}}: {{count}} of {{capacity}} places; + {{draft}} from this qualification
qualification.overCapacityWarning: Expected teams for “{{phase}}” would be {{count}} for {{capacity}} places (including {{draft}} from these qualifications).
qualification.duplicateWarning: Several qualifications use the same selection (same standing place).
qualification.duplicateTooltip: This selection is also used by another qualification
qualification.incompleteHintPlaceUnavailable: Place editing unavailable — switch to Entries or change phase
qualification.incompleteHintMultiSlot: Map a place for each selection
qualification.incompleteHintDuplicateSlot: Same place used more than once
qualification.incompleteHintDuplicatePlace: Place already targeted by another qualification
qualification.emptyBody: Add a qualification, or save to clear any existing rules.
qualification.emptyNoPeerBody: Add a downstream phase in Structure before you can define where teams qualify.
qualification.emptyNoPlacePeerBody: Place mode only lists Cup phases whose organisation exposes labeled places. No downstream phase is eligible. Choose Entries, or set up a downstream Cup phase.

attribution.title: Place awards — {{phase}}
attribution.hint: Award a final rank (1st, 2nd…) from the outcome of a confrontation in this phase.
attribution.incompleteHintUnknownFixture: Confrontation not found on this phase
attribution.nonContiguousWarning: Awarded ranks are not consecutive — a gap in the sequence may leave the outcome partial.
attribution.emptyBody: Choose a confrontation from the Add menu, or save to clear existing awards.
attribution.emptyNoFixtureBody: Create confrontations in this phase’s structure before awarding places.
